items.key: Check missing costs, unpaid invoices and supporting slips before sharing the report. Untagged costs are never allocated to crop profit.
items.draft: Hlola iindleko ezilahlekileyo, ii-invoyisi ezingahlawulwanga neerisithi ezixhasayo phambi kokwabelana ngengxelo. Iindleko ezingaphawulwanga azabelwa kwinzuzo yesityalo.
items.backtranslation: Check lost costs, unpaid invoices and supporting receipts... Costs not marked are not allocated to crop profit.
items.problem: "missing costs" (not recorded) rendered as "lost costs" (ezilahlekileyo); "never allocated" softened to "are not allocated". Money text.
items.corrected: Hlola iindleko ezingabhalwanga, ii-invoyisi ezingahlawulwanga neerisithi ezixhasayo phambi kokwabelana ngengxelo. Iindleko ezingaphawulwanga azisoze zabelwe kwinzuzo yesityalo.

items.key: All logged categories are included. Missing labour, depreciation, stock and other costs are not estimated.
items.draft: Zonke iindidi ezirekhodiweyo ziqukiwe. Umsebenzi, ukwehla kwexabiso, istokhwe nezinye iindleko ezilahlekileyo aziqikelelwanga.
items.backtranslation: All recorded categories are included. Work, drop in price, stock and other lost costs are not estimated.
items.problem: "Missing ... costs" (not logged) rendered as "lost costs"; "depreciation" rendered as "ukwehla kwexabiso" (a price drop, which could be read as market price). Money text.
items.corrected: Zonke iindidi ezirekhodiweyo ziqukiwe. Umsebenzi, ukwehla kwexabiso lezixhobo, istokhwe nezinye iindleko ezingabhalwanga aziqikelelwanga.
